restrict\nwhich destinations can be dialed from this number\n(e.g. \u003ccode\u003e^\\+1[0-9]{10}$\u003c/code\u003e for US only).\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen build the \u003cstrong\u003einbound flow\u003c/strong\u003e in the graph editor below — it decides\nwhat happens when someone calls the number:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAdd step\u003c/strong\u003e and pick a node: \u003cstrong\u003eQueue\u003c/strong\u003e (route to agents in a queue —\ncreate one under \u003cstrong\u003eQueues\u003c/strong\u003e first), \u003cstrong\u003eDial\u003c/strong\u003e / \u003cstrong\u003eDialGroup\u003c/strong\u003e (ring\nspecific agents), \u003cstrong\u003eMenu\u003c/strong\u003e (IVR keypad menu), \u003cstrong\u003ePlay\u003c/strong\u003e (play audio),\n\u003cstrong\u003eWeekTime\u003c/strong\u003e (business-hours branching), or \u003cstrong\u003eVoiceBot\u003c/strong\u003e (AI voice\nbot — needs the Deepgram/OpenAI keys from step 4).\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eDrag it into place.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eConnect \u003cstrong\u003eStart\u003c/strong\u003e to the first node, and node outlets onward.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThe simplest working flow is \u003cstrong\u003eStart → Dial\u003c/strong\u003e with \u003cstrong\u003eTo\u003c/strong\u003e set to your own\nusername (the SIP username you chose during setup). <p dir="auto">Run your own voice infrastructure on a single Linux box. Bring your own SIP trunk
(Twilio, Telnyx, …), run one install script, and you get:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Voice calls with browser-based dialers for agents</li>
<li>Phone numbers, queues, call recording</li>
<li>Call transcription, AI summaries, sentiment, semantic search</li>
<li>A real-time AI voice bot</li>
<li>Multi-tenant orgs, API keys, webhooks</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">🎬 <strong>Watch the installation walkthrough — from blank server to first call:</strong></p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://youtu.be/Cm4JDB95vpI" title="Play on YouTube" rel="nofollow"><img src="/comcent-io/comcent-ce/raw/main/.github/assets/install-walkthrough-thumb.jpg" alt="Watch the Comcent CE installation walkthrough on YouTube" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Minimum requirements</h2><a id="user-content-minimum-requirements" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Minimum requirements" href="#minimum-requirements"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>A Linux host with a public IPv4 — Ubuntu 22.04+ / Debian 12+ (a $12/mo
DigitalOcean droplet with 2 vCPU / 4 GB RAM is plenty)</li>
<li>A domain name you can point at it</li>
<li>A SIP trunk (Twilio, Telnyx, Bandwidth, …) if you want to make/receive
real phone calls</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">2. Point a domain at the host</h3><a id="user-content-2-point-a-domain-at-the-host" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 2. Point a domain at the host" href="#2-point-a-domain-at-the-host"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Create a DNS <strong>A record</strong> (e.g. <code>voice.yourdomain.com</code>) pointing at the
host's public IPv4. Verify with <code>dig +short voice.yourdomain.com</code> before
continuing — the HTTPS certificate can't be issued until DNS resolves.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">3. Run the installer</h3><a id="user-content-3-run-the-installer" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 3. Run the installer" href="#3-run-the-installer"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">SSH into the host and run:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/comcent-io/comcent-ce/main/install.sh | bash"><pre>curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/comcent-io/comcent-ce/main/install.sh <span class="pl-k">|</span> bash</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Takes ~30 seconds: installs Docker if missing, generates secrets, and
writes <code>docker-compose.yaml</code> + <code>.env</code> into <code>~/comcent-ce/</code>. It does <strong>not</strong>
start anything yet.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">4. Fill in <code>.env</code></h3><a id="user-content-4-fill-in-env" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 4. Fill in .env" href="#4-fill-in-env"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="nano ~/comcent-ce/.env"><pre>nano <span class="pl-k">~</span>/comcent-ce/.env</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Search for <code>replaceMe</code> and fill every one in:</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Variable</th>
<th>What</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>COMCENT_DOMAIN</code></td>
<td>Your hostname from step 2</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL</code></td>
<td>Email for cert-renewal alerts</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>SOURCE_EMAIL</code></td>
<td>Sender for invites / password resets</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>SMTP_URL</code></td>
<td><code>smtp://user:pass@host:port</code> — any provider works. Leave blank to disable email.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME</code>, <code>AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID</code>, <code>AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY</code></td>
<td>S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket for recordings & uploads</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto">Optional (leave blank to disable): <code>DEEPGRAM_API_KEY</code> (transcription,
voice bot), <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code> (AI summaries, voice bot), Sentry DSNs.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">5. Start it and claim your instance</h3><a id="user-content-5-start-it-and-claim-your-instance" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 5. Start it and claim your instance" href="#5-start-it-and-claim-your-instance"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="cd ~/comcent-ce
docker compose up -d"><pre><span class="pl-c1">cd</span> <span class="pl-k">~</span>/comcent-ce
docker compose up -d</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">First run pulls ≈800 MB of images and takes 5–10 minutes — that's normal.
The HTTPS certificate is issued about a minute after start.</p>
<p dir="auto">Once up, the server prints a one-time <strong>setup token</strong> for creating the
first admin account. Grab it from the logs:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose logs server | grep -A 10 "FIRST-RUN SETUP""><pre>docker compose logs server <span class="pl-k">|</span> grep -A 10 <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>FIRST-RUN SETUP<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then open <code>https://voice.yourdomain.com/setup</code>, enter the token along with
your name, email, password, and organization details. Done — you're the
super-admin.</p>
<p dir="auto">(Lost the token? It's re-printed on every server start until claimed —
<code>docker compose restart server</code>, then grep again.)</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">6. Connect your SIP trunk</h3><a id="user-content-6-connect-your-sip-trunk" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 6. Connect your SIP trunk" href="#6-connect-your-sip-trunk"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To make and receive real phone calls, open <strong>Sip Trunk</strong> in the sidebar,
hit <strong>Create</strong>, and fill in:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Name</strong> — anything, e.g. <code>twilio</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Provide Outbound Credentials</strong> — tick only if your trunk uses
username/password auth instead of IP-based auth.</li>
<li><strong>SIP Proxy Address</strong> — your provider's termination URI
(e.g. <code>mytrunk.pstn.twilio.com</code>).</li>
<li><strong>Inbound IPs to whitelist</strong> — comma-separated IPs/domains your provider
sends calls from.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">On the trunk provider's side:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Whitelist your host's public IP (<code><YOUR_IP>/32</code>) — e.g. Twilio's
<strong>IP Access Control Lists</strong> on an Elastic SIP Trunk.</li>
<li>Point inbound calls (Origination) at <code>sip:<YOUR_DOMAIN>?transport=udp</code>.</li>
<li>Route your phone number to the trunk, so calls to it reach this server.
Every provider names this differently — on Twilio you assign the number
to the Elastic SIP Trunk.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">7. Add the number and build its inbound flow</h3><a id="user-content-7-add-the-number-and-build-its-inbound-flow" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 7. Add the number and build its inbound flow" href="#7-add-the-number-and-build-its-inbound-flow"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Routing the number to the trunk on the provider's side isn't enough —
Comcent also needs to know the number and what to do with calls to it.
Open <strong>Numbers</strong> in the sidebar, hit <strong>Add</strong>, and fill in:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Name</strong> — a friendly label.</li>
<li><strong>Number (E.164)</strong> — the number you bought, e.g. <code>+15551234567</code>.</li>
<li><strong>SIP Trunk</strong> — pick the trunk from step 6.</li>
<li><strong>Allow Outbound if destination matches regex</strong> — optional; restrict
which destinations can be dialed from this number
(e.g. <code>^\+1[0-9]{10}$</code> for US only).</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Then build the <strong>inbound flow</strong> in the graph editor below — it decides
what happens when someone calls the number:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Add step</strong> and pick a node: <strong>Queue</strong> (route to agents in a queue —
create one under <strong>Queues</strong> first), <strong>Dial</strong> / <strong>DialGroup</strong> (ring
specific agents), <strong>Menu</strong> (IVR keypad menu), <strong>Play</strong> (play audio),
<strong>WeekTime</strong> (business-hours branching), or <strong>VoiceBot</strong> (AI voice
bot — needs the Deepgram/OpenAI keys from step 4).</li>
<li>Drag it into place.</li>
<li>Connect <strong>Start</strong> to the first node, and node outlets onward.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">The simplest working flow is <strong>Start → Dial</strong> with <strong>To</strong> set to your own
username (the SIP username you chose during setup). Hit <strong>Add</strong> to save,
then call your number — it rings in your browser dialer.</p>

<p dir="auto"><strong>Sign-up email never arrives.</strong> <code>SMTP_URL</code> is unset or wrong. For one-off
testing you can run a <a href="https://github.com/mailhog/MailHog">Mailhog</a>
container and set <code>SMTP_URL=smtp://mailhog:1025</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong><code>https://...</code> shows a Traefik default cert.</strong> Let's Encrypt couldn't
issue. Check <code>docker compose logs traefik</code> — usually DNS not yet pointing
at the host, or port 80 blocked.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>SIP trunk returns 403 on outbound.</strong> Your host's public IP is not on the
trunk's IP allow list. Add <code><your-IP>/32</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Browser dialer can't register.</strong> The dialer connects to
<code>wss://<COMCENT_DOMAIN>:5063/sip-ws</code>. Confirm port 5063/TCP is open and
serving a valid Let's Encrypt cert:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="echo | openssl s_client -connect voice.yourdomain.com:5063 -servername voice.yourdomain.com 2>/dev/null \
  | openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates"><pre><span class="pl-c1">echo</span> <span class="pl-k">|</span> openssl s_client -connect voice.yourdomain.com:5063 -servername voice.yourdomain.com <span class="pl-k">2></span>/dev/null \
  <span class="pl-k">|</span> openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates</pre></div>
